name: @sellright/storefront
description: A generic, themeable SellRight storefront built with Qwik

_comments.zod: v4 with classic compat layer — drop-in replacement for v3, zero code changes needed
_comments.qwik: Qwik core/router/eslint-plugin-qwik aligned on 2.0.0-rc.3 with Vite 8/Rolldown

scripts.build: pnpm run assert:no-vendure && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:l2 && pnpm run check:gateway && pnpm run check:surface && pnpm run build.types && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build.client && pnpm run build.server && node scripts/cleanup-static-sitemaps.js
scripts.build:demo: SELLRIGHT_DISABLE_SSG=1 SELLRIGHT_BUILD_SUFFIX=demo VITE_SELLRIGHT_API_URL=http://172.22.0.1:4310 VITE_SELLRIGHT_PROD_URL=http://172.22.0.1:4310 VITE_SERVER_CART=1 VITE_DEMO_MODE=1 VITE_HOME_SPOTLIGHT_SLUG=studio-notebook VITE_HOME_FEATURE_SLUG=everyday-tote pnpm run build
scripts.test:tools: node --test tools/compose/compose.test.mjs tools/compose/journal.test.mjs tools/compose/drift.test.mjs tools/compose/env-check.test.mjs tools/env/env-check.test.mjs tools/inventory/inventory.test.mjs tools/bump/bump.test.mjs tools/deploy/tools.test.mjs tools/deploy/entry.test.mjs tools/deploy/rollback.test.mjs tools/deploy/review3.test.mjs tools/deploy/review4.test.mjs tools/deploy/review5.test.mjs tools/deploy/review6.test.mjs tools/deploy/review7.test.mjs
scripts.e2e:build: pnpm run generate:placeholder-assets && rm -rf dist-e2e server-e2e && SELLRIGHT_DISABLE_SSG=1 SELLRIGHT_BUILD_SUFFIX=e2e pnpm run build.client && SELLRIGHT_DISABLE_SSG=1 SELLRIGHT_BUILD_SUFFIX=e2e pnpm run build.server
